coverage_legend.exact: The dataset subcategory closely matches the scope of the listed KB articles.
coverage_legend.broad: The dataset subcategory identifies a platform/domain; ticket text must select among several issue-specific KB articles.
coverage_legend.partial: The KB articles cover only some ticket patterns in this subcategory. Always retain full-vector fallback.
coverage_legend.unsupported: No sufficiently relevant KB article currently exists. Use full-vector fallback and consider authoring a dedicated article.
